subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ What property should be used to set how long the beeSprite appears on screen?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Should the code on Line 46 set how many lives the beeSprite starts with or how long it appears on the screen?


Solution: 

Property name updated to lifespan on line 46, so the code reads: 

beeSprite.lifespan = randint(2000, 5000)
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, there’s an error in the code!


Notice that the error message on the bottom says the problem is on Line 46: the property ‘life’ does not exist on type ‘Sprite’.


Fix the bugs in the code so that the beeSprite’s lifespan is set to a random integer between 2-5 seconds, when the project begins.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓ What sprite kind should the beeSprite be set to so the onOverlap code will run?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What sprite kinds are used as the kind and otherKind parameters in the onOverlap event?


Solution: 

The beeSprite’s sprite kind should be changed to SpriteKind.Enemy on Line 44.
steps.instructions:
When the playerSprite overlaps a beeSprite, nothing happens!


Fix the bugs in the code so that when the playerSprite overlaps a beeSprite, the beeSprite is destroyed.

subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: ❓ What sprite kind should the otherKind parameter be set to so the onOverlap code will run?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What sprite kind is used as the otherKind parameter in each onOverlap event?


Solution: 

The otherKind parameter in the onOverlap event on Line 74 should be changed from SpriteKind.honeySprite to SpriteKind.Food
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, there’s an error in the code!


Notice that the error message on the bottom says the problem is on Line 74: the property ‘honeySprite’ does not exist on ‘typeof SpriteKind’. 

Fix the bugs in the code so that when the Player sprite overlaps the Food sprite, the Food sprite changes position.

Ask the ninja: 

❓ What parameter should be used as the sprite name so that any sprite of the otherKind parameter is destroyed on overlap with the kind parameter?

sprites.destroy(beeSprite) should be changed to sprites.destroy(otherSprite)  inside the curly brackets of the Player/Enemy onOverlap event.

attributes.description: Welcome to Level 1 of Purple Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about sprite kinds and sprite overlap events. In the JavaScript editor, you can use a namespace to create new sprite kinds. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 1:

badges.title: One of a Kind
badges.description: Use sprite kinds and events to control what happens to sprites in a project in JavaScript.

badges.title: A Meeting of the Kinds
badges.description: Use an overlap event that runs based on the sprites’ kinds.

badges.title: Nice Knowing Ya
badges.description: Write code that destroys a sprite.

badges.title: Life of the Party
badges.description: Set the value of the Player’s life.

badges.title: From One Sprite to Another
badges.description: Create a projectile that starts from the position of an existing sprite.

badges.title: Metamorphosis
badges.description: Change the sprite kind of an existing sprite.

badges.title: Kind of You to Join
badges.description: Create a new sprite kind in JavaScript.

badges.title: New Kind on the Block
badges.description: Write code that runs when a sprite with a specific sprite kind is created.

badges.title: Out of Chances
badges.description: Write code that runs when the Player’s life reaches zero.

badges.title: Spice Up Your Life
badges.description: Set the image used to represent the Player’s life.
